semantics.definition: A question and its choices: a real fieldset and legend.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one choices every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Put a question with its radios or checkboxes, so screen readers say the question with every choice.

layout.across: across, in a row that wraps
